name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
summary: At the Stonefield homestead in south-central Elwynn Forest, “Auntie” Bernice Stonefield keeps watch over the neighborhood. Widowed when her husband fell in the kingdom’s military campaigns, she is known throughout the valley for her pork belly pies. She stays outside the farmhouse beside Ma Stonefield and remains deeply suspicious of the rival Maclure family.

sections.title: A Life of Hardship
sections.body: Bernice carries the cost of war, as many common folk in the Kingdom of Stormwind do. Her husband fell in military campaigns, and she now lives with her kin at the family homestead. She helps Ma Stonefield manage the farm’s daily affairs, keeping the household fed and running. Her pork belly pies have made her famous among the people of the valley.

sections.title: The Feud and the Missing Necklace
sections.body: For Bernice, the old bitterness between the Stonefields and the Maclures runs deep. When her prized family necklace went missing, she suspected young Billy Maclure of taking it. Recovering it proves more complicated than settling a neighbor’s prank. Billy swears he did not steal the necklace, but nearly admits he dropped it near the Fargodeep Mine. There, he saw the gold-toothed kobold Goldtooth snatch it and carry it to his den.

faq.answer: “Auntie” Bernice Stonefield is an elder of the Stonefield family who lives at the Stonefield Farm in southern Elwynn Forest. Widowed by the kingdom’s wars, she tends the farm with Ma Stonefield and is known for her pork belly pies.

faq.q: What happened to Auntie Bernice's husband?
faq.answer: Bernice’s husband fell during a military campaign fought for the Kingdom of Stormwind, leaving her a widow.

faq.q: What is Auntie Bernice famous for?
faq.answer: Bernice is known across the local countryside for her pork belly pies, which even mischievous neighbors will bargain for a slice of.

faq.q: Why is Auntie Bernice angry with Billy Maclure?
faq.answer: Bernice suspects Billy Maclure took her cherished family necklace, deepening the long-standing feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures.

faq.q: Did Billy Maclure actually steal the necklace?
faq.answer: Billy swears he did not steal Bernice’s necklace, though he nearly admits he dropped it near the Fargodeep Mine. He says the gold-toothed kobold Goldtooth picked it up and carried it to his den.
Bernice can be found outside the main farmhouse at Stonefield Farm, south of the road between Goldshire and Westfall, beside Ma Stonefield.

angles.text: Bernice’s pork belly pie is famous across Elwynn Forest as a staple of hearty human frontier cooking.
As a human, Bernice shows the resilience of Stormwind’s rural folk, carrying on daily life and family pride after her husband fell in the kingdom’s wars.
